fields.label: Keyspace
fields.help: Vitess sequence backing tables must be in an unsharded keyspace; a sharded one is refused before anything runs.

fields.label: Next value
fields.help: The first value the sequence issues.

fields.label: Cache size
fields.help: Values vttablet reserves per block; each block costs one backing-table write.

fields.label: Next value
fields.help: The next unreserved value (the backing table's next_id). vttablet issues values from cached blocks, so values already issued can trail it by up to one cache block; set it above any value in use.
